roles.purpose: Audit the dialer's telephony, legal, carrier, audit-honesty, action-authority, and tenant-isolation invariants across STIR/SHAKEN, 10DLC, TCPA/CASL calling hours, DNC, recording disclosure, and ARC-006 without editing.
trigger: before merging work that dials, texts, records, stores prospect data, or mutates number state
required_outputs: findings by severity with quoted file-line evidence
compliance and authority invariants checked and found clean
pressure-tested fix proposals (FIX-PROVEN or FIX-PLAUSIBLE, defaulting to PLAUSIBLE)

criteria.summary: Every dial, text, and recording action is gated by a verified authority tier at the source, not by a caller's claim.
DNC state, consent, and TCPA/CASL calling hours are enforced before the action fires, per tenant and per jurisdiction.
Recording disclosure and retention obey the jurisdiction rule for the parties on the call.
STIR/SHAKEN attestation and 10DLC registration integrity hold for the number actually used.
The audit trail records what actually happened, including failures and suppressed attempts.

roles.purpose: Find contradictions between dialer code and its settled ADRs, decision log, ARC-006 tiers, centralization registries, and source-of-truth maps, including contradictions between doctrine artifacts themselves.
trigger: before merging behavior governed by an ADR, decision-log row, authority tier, or central registry
required_outputs: findings by severity with governing-authority quotes
doctrine artifacts and behaviors checked and found consistent
honesty clause naming unreached doctrine or code
pressure-tested fix proposals (FIX-PROVEN or FIX-PLAUSIBLE, defaulting to PLAUSIBLE)

criteria.summary: Behavior matches the ARC-006 tier and decision-log row that governs it, quoted from the authority.
Central registries remain the single source; no consumer restates a value the registry owns.
Doctrine artifacts agree with each other, not only with the code.
Retired statuses, values, and paths are gone from living docs, not merely unused in code.

roles.purpose: Audit the internet-exposed multi-tenant dialer from an attacker's perspective across auth, CSRF, RBAC and object scope, tenant isolation and RLS, untrusted input, secrets, PII telemetry, abuse controls, provider boundaries, and dependency risk.
trigger: before merging auth, security, privacy, billing, upload, provider, tenant-data, or prospect-data changes
required_outputs: threat-path findings with attack scenarios and evidence
security passes checked and found clean
pressure-tested fix proposals (FIX-PROVEN or FIX-PLAUSIBLE, defaulting to PLAUSIBLE)

criteria.summary: Every route authorized server-side by capability and scope; every client-supplied identifier scope-verified.
Tenant predicate on every scoped query and the RLS backstop verified verbatim against the canonical migration, not by comment.
Cookie-first sessions, server-side revocation, CSRF binding, and account-existence non-disclosure.
External input schema-validated before business logic; uploads and rendered content sanitized.
No hardcoded or committed secrets; webhook signatures verified timing-safe; provider scopes minimal.
Logs, error envelopes, and telemetry routed through the shared redaction authority; no prospect PII in any sink.
Expensive and auth endpoints limited and cost-attributed to the billed principal, not IP alone.
Model output never decides authorization or billing; user content treated as untrusted prompt input.
Carrier and provider payloads treated as untrusted, and no credential or payload crosses a boundary it should not.

roles.purpose: Run the serialized local CI-equivalent heavy gate as the sole local test-database user, preserve command-owned exit codes and nonzero test counts, and return a compact diagnosis without editing.
trigger: after a finished dialer slice requires the heavy local proof ladder
required_outputs: nonzero test file and test counts
one root cause and suggested fix per failure

criteria.summary: Each command's own exit status captured before any pipe, never a tailed or echoed status.
Suites actually executed with nonzero file and case counts; a conditional skip reported as unrun.
The test-database lease was held for the run with no concurrent worktree user.
One root cause and suggested fix per failure, traced to the line rather than the summary.

roles.purpose: Implement one settled bounded dialer slice completely in an isolated worktree, self-audit the actual diff, run the authorized fast gates, and return evidence to the orchestrator.
trigger: a settled self-contained dialer sprint slice
required_outputs: approved design reference for any visible frontend work
rendered evidence for any visible frontend work
